title: Restore the source-qualified UFS host check in main and run the UFS and GPT read-only checks from make check (DRV-002 closure inputs)
acceptance: src/platform/storage/ufs/check.py passes on main by reading the pinned Samsung sources from the s24-linux object store when no session cache exists; the exact bytes are still verified by the profile sha256 and git blob id, and lazy fetch stays disabled.

tests/test_ufs_contract.py runs the UFS host check and the GPT check under make check, asserts their pass outcome and key counts, and skips only with a stated reason when the pinned references or host clang are absent.

docs/procedures/drv-002 maps each DRV-002 acceptance criterion (DMA/GPT/LUN boundaries, timeouts, write rejection, userdata not assumed readable, no PHY/IOMMU/MCQ hardware claim) to a concrete existing check, without claiming any hardware result.
No phone, MMIO or storage access.
steps: Add an object-store source candidate to check.py
Wire both checks into a unittest
Write the DRV-002 acceptance map and evidence
